notes: Products, example amounts and neutral labels are transcribed from the supplied board. Unit spacing is normalized for readability; the generated board is not a commercial product specification.
Counts must describe actual fixture data; do not hardcode the board's 32 products or two current orders when the dataset has fewer. Do not invent extra products/orders merely to copy a badge.
The second historical/current sample order in the board shows RM25.40, but its itemization is not supplied; this package does not fabricate its line items.
Keep initial browse and after-add capture states explicit. Card steppers and badges must agree with the actual sample cart, even where individual board snapshots are inconsistent.
Expected RM18.00 is a computed test expectation. On quantity/address/quote changes, use the existing calculations/requote behavior; never pin the UI to the sample total.
No support phone number is supplied. No generated retailer logo, certification, Fresh/Local Supplier/Quality Assured badge, provider page, or real payment result is supplied.
